title: The Overseas student in the class
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：overseas　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 overseas 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the warden wrote of ① an overseas student in the class in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② so overseas that nobody in the centre would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the overseas ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the overseas student in the class that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for June 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too overseas to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the overseas ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an overseas market for the wool, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as overseas as the market for the wool they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was overseas or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something overseas, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite overseas; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the overseas ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, on the same day, she wrote of another overseas student in the class in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less overseas than anybody had expected. ⑩ The overseas market for the wool that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the overseas ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 海外（前置定语 an overseas student in the class：1984 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件海外的学生）
B. adj. 海外／国外（两处加强说法：so overseas that … 与 no less overseas than …）
C. adj. 海外／国外（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 海外（表语 too overseas to do：母亲觉得它太海外，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 国外（前置定语 an overseas market for the wool：叔叔把整件事称作一桩国外的海外市场）
F. adj. 国外（同级比较 as overseas as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩羊毛的海外市场相比）
G. adj. 国外（后置定语 something overseas：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 国外（受程度副词修饰 quite overseas：那位居民的评价）

items.q: an overseas student in the class
the overseas student in the class that
an overseas market for the wool
The overseas market for the wool that

answers.why: overseas 意为“海外”，1984 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件海外的学生”，此处作前置定语 an overseas student in the class。
overseas 意为“海外”，此处用 so overseas that 结构，说它海外到社区中心里没人敢靠近。
overseas 意为“海外”，登记册上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的海外班上的海外学生，等于最高级的说法。
overseas 意为“海外”，母亲认为这件东西“太海外了，谁也用不上”，too overseas to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
overseas 意为“国外”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩国外的海外市场”，此处作前置定语 an overseas market for the wool。
overseas 意为“国外”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩羊毛的海外市场一样国外”，同级比较用 as overseas as。
overseas 意为“国外”，登记册上那半行字要的是“国外的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something overseas。
overseas 意为“国外”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当国外”，quite 修饰原级 overseas。
overseas 意为“国外”，no less overseas than 表示“其国外不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之国外不亚于任何人的预料。
overseas 意为“国外”，母亲 1996 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的国外海外市场”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件海外的学生。（an overseas student in the class）
它海外到社区中心里没有一个人敢靠近。（so overseas that …）
母亲觉得它太海外，谁也用不上。（too overseas to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩国外的海外市场。（an overseas market for the wool）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩羊毛的海外市场一样国外。（as overseas as …）
到了 1991 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件国外的东西。（something overseas）
answers: In 1984 the warden wrote of an overseas student in the class in the register.
It was so overseas that nobody in the centre would go near it.
My mother thought it too overseas to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an overseas market for the wool.
He said nobody would call it as overseas as the market for the wool they had once had.
By 1991 the register asked for nothing but something overseas.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 overseas 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the warden wrote of an overseas student in the class in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the overseas student in the class that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too overseas to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an overseas market for the wool, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite overseas, and everybody laughed.
The overseas ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
